Being that tarot primary functions on energy channelled through the reader of the cards, I didn't know if it would be possible for accurate information to flow through the impersonal medium I associate the Internet as being. I was wrong! Pleasantly surprised, I am always guided by just the right card at the right time. If your interested in exploring tarot or just (like me) find it inconvenient to cart your cards everywhere you go, then this is the app for you.
